checks.title: Icon rocket 'Update campaign' mo modal LIET KE cac campaign dang dung product de nguoi dung TU MO campaign - KHONG phai co che tu dong day (push) thay doi vao campaign (CONFIRMED)
checks.precondition: Co 1 product base dang duoc 1 campaign dung
steps: Bam icon rocket 'Update campaign' tren 1 dong product dang duoc campaign dung
Quan sat modal 'Campaigns that use this product' mo ra: banner, bang danh sach campaign (ID/NAME/UPDATED/STATUS/LOGS, checkbox chon dong), nut 'Update' rieng
checks.observation_point: Noi dung modal + cac control co san (banner, bang, nut Update)
checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED (PO xac nhan 'viec update campaign trong product base... hien len nhung campaign dang su dung product base/artwork nay... khong phai muc dich de update product base/artwork vao campaign', 2026-09-13 + evidence run CTX-20260913-02 act_id=ACT-08-RC-007-001): bam icon rocket 'Update campaign' mo modal 'Campaigns that use this product' voi banner 'Please update your campaign after editing product base details', bang danh sach campaign dang dung product (ID/NAME/UPDATED/STATUS/LOGS, co checkbox chon dong), va 1 nut 'Update' rieng o goc tren. Hanh vi CHINH la LIET KE de nguoi dung tu mo campaign (khop PO: muc dich khong phai tu dong day thay doi product base/artwork vao campaign, ma la 'update campaign ngoai SDK'). GIOI HAN PHAM VI (BLOCKING con lai): nut 'Update' ro rang nhu mot hanh dong push-update that nhung CHUA duoc bam trong run nao (gioi han an toan mutation) - hanh vi that khi bam VAN CHUA CO EVIDENCE, khong duoc suy dien.
